title: Doey brings an exciting sound to life on the new song "CouldBeSorry"
htmlContent:
Fast-rising music star, Doey is a multi-talented singer and songwriter from Long Island, New york. Doey is one of the hottest upcoming artists in his area and is rising more than most. Doey is presently making waves with the release of his recent track, "CouldBeSorry." A new project promises to be blazing with his trademark melodic beats.

Doey, on his recent track, "CouldBeSorry," is all about being confused about which path to take and what will lead you to the right place. The talented lyrical genius wants to create a unique sound for his fans.
